event_data.context: Roadmap ticket 3 / Phase 1. Prove codex app-server can serve as Tiber's sole inference transport without loading user Codex configuration or executing undeclared tools. The spike must preserve the shipped advisory plugin and its review orchestration. Tiber's native contract must retain risk assessment, independent review lenses, verifier routing, durable review state, delta reassessment, and clean-review gating rather than losing those behaviors during the authority cutover.
event_data.summary: Deliver the first standalone x86_64 Linux Tiber executable slice: an isolated codex app-server conversation with app-server-mediated auth, inert typed tool requests, and a Codex-compatible TUI, while explicitly preserving the existing multi-agent final-review orchestration contract for native migration.
event_data.title: Prove Tiber can run an isolated Codex conversation
